svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the tube 1,742 mm long, square ends; weld a 100 x 100 x 6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cap on top (20 mm coax hole, four M5 tapped holes at 20 each way).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights below are from the sidewalk; the tube starts 12 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front wall (head side): four 11 mm holes 25 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: center at 1,100 and 1,660; one 25 mm cable hole at 1,380.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back wall (cabinet side): four 11 mm holes 25 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 360 and 700; one 25 mm cable hole at 735.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Countersink the 11 mm holes 90 degrees for flush rivet nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld to the base plate, then hot-dip galvanize and powder coat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After coating: set eight M8 flush steel rivet nuts; clean

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the threads; deburr the cable holes and fit grommets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: an M8 screw runs into every rivet nut by hand.
